referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes an inverter used in the power electronics of the drivetrain for an electric passenger car. It is based on direct information from Swiss manufacturer Brusa. The entries are given as a function of kg device. The specific inverter which was used for this dataset weights 9.5 kg and is suitable for a 100kW electric drivetrain.; UUID: 934d7e9d-2c5c-3bed-bd39-25342412bd01
